interventions.detail: README has no install-from-source steps; used AGENTS.md flow: venv, local-requirements.txt, upstream.py checkout, python -m build --wheel, install wheel
Installed Node.js v26.13.1 (NODE_VERSION) from nodejs.org; npm is needed to build the driver from .upstream/
Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/ms-playwright so the browser location is fixed and env.sh can point to it
